info.title: Elon Uz API
info.description:
v1 API specification for the Elon Uz super-app.

This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the API. Every new feature module adds the
endpoints it needs here, then `./gradlew :dev:api-client-generator:generateAllApi` is run
and the Kotlin client (`dev.core.network.generated.api.*`) is generated automatically.

The base URL already ends with `/v1` (`CoreModules.DEV_BASE_URL`), so paths here are written
without a version prefix: `/profile/me` -> `https://api.elon.uz/v1/profile/me`.

Authorization: every request carries a Firebase ID token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
(Ktor `Auth` plugin, `FirebaseTokenProvider`).

RESPONSE ENVELOPE: every response (success and error) is wrapped in the BaseResponse envelope
`{success,status,code,message,result,error}`. The response schemas below describe the `result`
payload only. See `docs/backend/BACKEND_PROMPT.md` section 2 for the full contract.

tags.name: Redemptions

get.description: The user is resolved from the Bearer token. Returns 404 if the profile has not been created yet.

404.description: Profile has not been created yet

put.description: Creates the profile if it does not exist, updates it otherwise (upsert).

post.description: The image is sent as multipart. The server stores it and returns its public URL; that URL is then written to the profile's `avatarUrl` field.

file.description: Image file (JPEG or PNG, max 5 MB)

get.description: The 7 active types and their default price unit. Personalised when `gender` is supplied: MALE excludes BEAUTY_SALON, FEMALE excludes BARBERSHOP.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: User gender — filters the list of types. All types are returned when omitted.

get.summary: List categories for a business type
get.description: For example, for CAFE_RESTAURANT: NATIONAL, PIZZA, BURGER, ... Every type also has ALL and OTHER. For CLOTHING `gender` is optional, but when supplied gender-specific categories are returned (MALE → SHIRTS/PANTS/SUITS..., FEMALE → DRESSES/SKIRTS/BLOUSES...).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender-specific categories for CLOTHING. Ignored for other types.

get.summary: JSON Schema for a listing's `attributes` field
get.description: The client builds the listing form DYNAMICALLY from this schema — type-specific fields are never hardcoded in the app. Adding a new field on the backend works without shipping a new app release.

post.summary: Geocode an address string to coordinates
post.description: Proxied through the backend to Yandex Geocoder (the API key never reaches the client). Results are approximate — the app asks the user to confirm them on the map.

post.summary: Reverse geocode coordinates to an address
post.description: Used to auto-fill the branch form when a point is picked on the map.

422.description: LOCATION_OUT_OF_BOUNDS — the coordinates fall outside Uzbekistan

post.description: Created with status = DRAFT. `type` cannot be changed afterwards. A user may own at most 5 businesses.

403.description: FORBIDDEN_ROLE — the user's role is not BUSINESS

put.description: Editing an APPROVED business sends it back to moderation (PENDING_REVIEW).

delete.description: All of the business's listings become ARCHIVED.

post.description: At most 50 branches per business. No duplicate branch within a 100 m radius.

delete.description: The last active branch cannot be deleted while active listings exist.

409.description: NO_ACTIVE_BRANCH — this is the last active branch

post.description: Created with status = DRAFT. `finalPrice` is computed by the SERVER — it is never accepted from the client. Call /listings/{id}/submit to publish.

put.description: On an ACTIVE listing, changing title/description/images/discount/originalPrice/categoryKey sends it back to moderation (PENDING_REVIEW). Changes to branchIds, validTo, totalLimit, stockCount, seatsLeft or option.isAvailable are saved immediately.

409.description: INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION — a listing in PENDING_REVIEW cannot be edited; withdraw it first

post.description: DRAFT | REJECTED -> PENDING_REVIEW. Checks: the business is APPROVED, it has an active branch with a complete location, at least 1 image, finalPrice < originalPrice, validTo is in the future, the category matches the business type, attributes match the schema, and active listings do not exceed 100.
Used to re-publish an EXPIRED/SOLD_OUT listing. The copy is a DRAFT with usedCount = 0.

get.summary: Who redeemed the discount and when

post.description: Checks that the code is valid and within its limits. Does NOT change the counter.
Increments usedCount and records the redemption in the student's history. A code cannot be redeemed twice.

post.summary: Upload an image (logo, cover, listing photo)
post.description: JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB, min 600x600. The server converts to WebP and stores 3 sizes.

purpose.description: Image purpose: LOGO | COVER | LISTING. Declared as a plain string rather than an enum, because an enum here makes the generated multipart code depend on Ktor's internal API.

get.summary: List discounts for a student (geo search)
get.description: ACTIVE listings only. When `lat`/`lng` are supplied, each listing is returned with its nearest branch and the distance to it. The student's coordinates are NOT STORED — they are used only to compute distance for the duration of the request.

avatarUrl.description: Public URL of the profile picture (returned by POST /profile/me/avatar)
Public URL of the uploaded image

UpdateProfileRequestDto.description: Request to save a profile. Fields left unset (null) are not modified.

BusinessTypeDto.description: Business type key (e.g. GAME_CLUB). Chosen when the business is created and IMMUTABLE afterwards, because categories and `attributes` depend on it. NOT an enum — the value set is data-driven: `GET /business/types` returns the available types from the backend, so new types are added as data (a table row) without changing this spec or releasing the app. Known seed keys: GAME_CLUB, CLOTHING, CAFE_RESTAURANT, EDUCATION_CENTER, ENTERTAINMENT, BARBERSHOP, BEAUTY_SALON. BARBERSHOP/BEAUTY_SALON are filtered by the user's gender (`GET /business/types?gender=`).

priceUnits.description: Price units valid for this type (the first one is the default)

BusinessStatusDto.description: DRAFT -> PENDING_REVIEW -> APPROVED | REJECTED -> (BLOCKED). No listing can be published until the business is APPROVED.

PriceUnitDto.description: Price unit: item, hour, kg, month, course, lesson, ticket, person, session

isOnlineOnly.description: When true, no branch or location is required (e.g. an online course)

UpdateBusinessRequestDto.description: `type` is absent here — the business type is immutable.

LocationDto.description: Branch location. The coordinates must fall within Uzbekistan and no more than 10 km from the selected district.

landmark.description: Landmark — the most useful field for students

geohash.description: Computed by the server (7 characters ~150 m). Not accepted from the client.

WorkingHoursDto.description: All 7 days must be supplied. When `close` < `open` the venue stays open overnight (20:00-04:00).

DeliveryZoneDto.description: Delivery zone — mainly for GROCERY and CAFE_RESTAURANT. `radiusMeters` is required when `enabled` is true.

regionId.description: Restrict the search to a region

fields.description: The fields shown in the form when this category is selected (order matters).

requiresCustomName.description: True for OTHER — `customCategoryName` then becomes required

CategoryDto.description: A category and its fields. `fields[]` contains `options[]`, so PlayStation → Model → PS5/PS4/PS3 all arrive in a single request.

DiscountTypeDto.description: PERCENT: value = 1..90 percent. FIXED_AMOUNT: value = discount in soums. SPECIAL_PRICE: value = the new price. FREE_ITEM: 1+1, with the terms in `conditions`.

finalPrice.description: Computed by the SERVER. finalPrice < originalPrice (except for FREE_ITEM).

appliesToOptions.description: False — the discount applies only to the base price, not to add-ons (priceDelta).

DiscountRequestDto.description: `finalPrice` is absent here — the server computes it.

RedemptionMethodDto.description: QR: the app shows a QR code. PROMO_CODE: the student reads out a code. STUDENT_ID: the student shows their profile. ONLINE_LINK: an external link.

totalLimit.description: null = unlimited. The listing moves to SOLD_OUT once usedCount >= totalLimit.

priceDelta.description: Amount added to the base price (may be negative)

OptionGroupDto.description: Add-on choices. 'Size' in a cafe, 'Hall type' in a game club, 'Size' in clothing, 'Storage' in electronics. Max 10 groups, 30 options each.

ListingAttributesDto.description:
Business-type-specific fields — a free-form key/value map (values are strings, exactly as the
form submits them).

The backend validates them PER TYPE with a JSON Schema (GET /business/types/{type}/attributes-schema),
and the client builds the form dynamically from that same schema. That is why there is no rigid
structure here: adding a new field changes neither this spec nor the app.

Keys by business type (full description — DISCOUNTS_BUSINESS_API.md §4):
- `hallType` [GAME_CLUB] — STANDARD | VIP | PRIVATE_ROOM
- `seatsCount` [GAME_CLUB] — number of seats/gamepads
- `deviceModel` [GAME_CLUB] — e.g. PlayStation 5 Slim
- `sessionMinutes` [GAME_CLUB] — length of a single session
- `gamesList` [GAME_CLUB]
- `hasNightPackage` [GAME_CLUB] — night package
- `nightPackagePrice` [GAME_CLUB]
- `minPlayers` [GAME_CLUB]
- `maxPlayers` [GAME_CLUB]
- `brand` [GROCERY, CLOTHING, ELECTRONICS]
- `weightGrams` [GROCERY]
- `volumeMl` [GROCERY]
- `packageType` [GROCERY] — BOX | BOTTLE | PACK | WEIGHT
- `expiryDate` [GROCERY]
- `storageCondition` [GROCERY]
- `composition` [GROCERY] — ingredients
- `stockCount` [GROCERY, CLOTHING, ELECTRONICS] — remaining stock. null = unlimited. Changes without moderation.
- `gender` [CLOTHING] — MALE | FEMALE | UNISEX | KIDS
- `sizes` [CLOTHING] — S, M, L or 39, 40, 41
- `sizeSystem` [CLOTHING] — INTERNATIONAL | EU | US | NUMERIC
- `colors` [CLOTHING]
- `material` [CLOTHING]
- `season` [CLOTHING] — WINTER | SPRING | SUMMER | AUTUMN | ALL_SEASON
- `hasFittingRoom` [CLOTHING]
- `returnDays` [CLOTHING] — return window
- `portionGrams` [CAFE_RESTAURANT]
- `calories` [CAFE_RESTAURANT]
- `ingredients` [CAFE_RESTAURANT]
- `allergens` [CAFE_RESTAURANT] — GLUTEN | MILK | EGG | NUTS | SEAFOOD | SOY
- `spicyLevel` [CAFE_RESTAURANT] — NONE | MILD | MEDIUM | HOT
- `isVegetarian` [CAFE_RESTAURANT]
- `isHalal` [CAFE_RESTAURANT, GROCERY]
- `cookingMinutes` [CAFE_RESTAURANT]
- `servingType` [CAFE_RESTAURANT] — DINE_IN | TAKEAWAY | DELIVERY
- `hasDelivery` [CAFE_RESTAURANT, GROCERY]
- `deliveryMinutes` [CAFE_RESTAURANT]
- `minOrderAmount` [CAFE_RESTAURANT, GROCERY]
- `availableHours` [CAFE_RESTAURANT, ENTERTAINMENT] — window in which the discount applies, e.g. 12:00-17:00
- `subject` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `level` [EDUCATION_CENTER] — BEGINNER | ELEMENTARY | INTERMEDIATE | ADVANCED
- `format` [EDUCATION_CENTER] — OFFLINE | ONLINE | HYBRID. [ENTERTAINMENT] 2D | 3D | IMAX | IMAX_3D | 4DX | VR
- `groupType` [EDUCATION_CENTER] — GROUP | INDIVIDUAL | MINI_GROUP
- `groupSize` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `durationMonths` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `lessonsPerWeek` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `lessonMinutes` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `teacherName` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `teacherBio` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `startDate` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `schedule` [EDUCATION_CENTER] — e.g. Mon, Wed, Fri - 18:00
- `hasFreeTrialLesson` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `hasCertificate` [EDUCATION_CENTER]
- `seatsLeft` [EDUCATION_CENTER, ENTERTAINMENT] — Changes without moderation.
- `eventTitle` [ENTERTAINMENT]
- `language` [ENTERTAINMENT] — UZ | RU | EN | ORIGINAL_SUB
- `durationMinutes` [ENTERTAINMENT]
- `ageLimit` [ENTERTAINMENT] — 0 | 6 | 12 | 16 | 18
- `sessionTimes` [ENTERTAINMENT] — showtimes
- `eventDate` [ENTERTAINMENT] — one-off event
- `hallName` [ENTERTAINMENT]
- `seatsTotal` [ENTERTAINMENT]
- `minPersons` [ENTERTAINMENT] — for quests
- `maxPersons` [ENTERTAINMENT]
- `includesEquipment` [ENTERTAINMENT] — whether equipment is included in the price
- `ticketType` [ENTERTAINMENT] — STANDARD | VIP | FAMILY | GROUP
- `model` [ELECTRONICS]
- `condition` [ELECTRONICS] — NEW | REFURBISHED | USED
- `warrantyMonths` [ELECTRONICS]
- `color` [ELECTRONICS]
- `specs` [ELECTRONICS] — free-form key/value, max 20 entries
- `hasInstallment` [ELECTRONICS, EDUCATION_CENTER] — installment plan
- `installmentMonths` [ELECTRONICS]
- `installmentMonthlyPrice` [ELECTRONICS]
- `isOfficialSeller` [ELECTRONICS]

ListingStatusDto.description: DRAFT -> PENDING_REVIEW -> ACTIVE <-> PAUSED. Automatic: EXPIRED (validTo has passed), SOLD_OUT (the limit is used up), SCHEDULED (validFrom has not arrived yet).

branchIds.description: When empty — all active branches of the business

images.description: The first one is the cover

rejectionReason.description: FAKE_DISCOUNT | POOR_IMAGE | PROHIBITED_CONTENT | WRONG_CATEGORY | INCOMPLETE_INFO | OTHER + a comment

UpdateListingRequestDto.description: Fields left unset (null) are not modified.

code.description: The promo code scanned from the QR or read out by the student

branchId.description: The branch where it was redeemed

NearestBranchDto.description: The branch nearest to the student. `distanceMeters` is populated only when lat/lng are supplied in the request.

DiscountCardDto.description: The condensed listing a student sees in the results list.

ErrorDto.description: Every error is returned in this format.

GenderDto.description: User gender — chosen during sign-up. Personalises business types and clothing categories.

AttributeFieldTypeDto.description: The field's UI type. SELECT — one choice, MULTI_SELECT — several choices.

AttributeFieldDto.description: A single field of the listing form. The client renders the UI from `type` alone — adding a new field needs no app update.

required.description: The listing cannot be published unless this is filled in

multiple.description: True for MULTI_SELECT. The value is stored comma-separated: "S,M,L"
